project_overview: This project appears to be a Vue.js application likely related to an examination or educational platform. It utilizes a layered architecture with distinct views for various pages such as exam submissions, fee details, and results. The presence of ‘iLike’ components suggests a user engagement feature, and the inclusion of ‘Transactions’ implies a backend interaction system. The application’s core functionality centers around managing user data and providing access to relevant information, heavily reliant on routing and dynamic component rendering.
